## Ctx.userName property

The Telegram username from the user profile.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get userName(): string;
```

## Remarks

May be `undefined` if the user has not set a username.

## Example


```typescript
async callback() {
  console.log(this.userName) // "gramstax_user"
}
```
